propositions: A hard clarity floor rule must be structurally incompatible with executable plans and tested against closed tickets with both plan-review and completion attestations to eliminate false positives.
Nonempty parsed acceptance criteria items (joined continuations, excluding whitespace-empty bodies) qualify as a hard clarity floor with zero historical counterexamples.

Unresolved sentinel detection must be narrowed to sentinel-as-value forms (TBD/TODO/FIXME/???) in exact active execution sections, outside code fences, with removal/negation assertions suppressed; c244-ba53-6280-4702 serves as the required PASS control.

Exact duplicate normalized AC items and [rebar:id] direct-edge validation are removed from hard clarity and reclassified as advisory or grounding-exception-only respectively, based on legitimate counterexamples.
File-impact path/reason integrity and preferred section presence are rejected as raw clarity signals and moved to write-schema validation and advisory coaching respectively.
